description: A PHP trait for cache tag checksum implementations in Drupal, handling delayed cache tag invalidations, checksum calculations, and cache tag preloading.

methods.name: rootTransactionEndCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked after a database transaction ends to invalidate delayed cache tags if successful.

methods.name: invalidateTags
methods.description: Invalidates specified cache tags, with support for delayed invalidation during transactions.

methods.name: getCurrentChecksum
methods.description: Calculates and returns the checksum for a set of cache tags, considering delayed invalidations.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a given checksum is valid for a set of cache tags, considering delayed invalidations.

methods.name: calculateChecksum
methods.description: Computes the checksum for a set of cache tags, including preload tags.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal caches and invalidation states.

methods.name: registerCacheTagsForPreload
methods.description: Registers cache tags for preloading, excluding delayed tags.
